body_lead: Andhra CM Naidu urges Google to expedite Vizag AI data centre Andhra Pradesh CM Naidu urged Google to expedite its AI Data Centre in Visakhapatnam during the World Economic Forum, discussing further tech collaborations. Andhra Pradesh chief minister N Chandrababu Naidu on Tuesday appealed to the software giant Google to expedite its proposed Artificial Intelligence Data Centre at Visakhapatnam. The chief minister held a meeting with Google Cloud chief executive officer Thomas Kurien on the second day of the World Economic Forum summit at Davos in Switzerland.
